description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy values for different models, labeled CoD, CCoT, and CoUT. The horizontal axis displays the model names—CoD, CCoT, and CoUT—in that order, with each model represented by a group of four bars. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 600, with tick marks at intervals of 50. Each model has four bars representing different runs, colored blue, red, orange, and green. For CoD, the bar heights are approximately 91.19, 88.50, 88.40, and 80.89. For CCoT, the bar heights are approximately 534.24, 445.91, 354.46, and 91.19. For CoUT, the bar heights are approximately 676.85, 445.91, 354.46, and 88.40. The bars are not explicitly sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
